regime: Fed hike being priced after a hot inflation report
takeaway: October consumer prices rose 0.4% and core prices 0.3%, both above forecasts, and the 2-year Treasury yield jumped about 15 bp to 4.70%, a move that matches past patterns where a Fed hike gets priced in. Gold had already slipped about 1.6% to near $4,075 and silver about 2% before the report, after Fed Governor Waller said a half-point December hike is possible. Stock futures turned lower after Monday's big rally, while Brent fell below $90.
